purpose: Starter source-discovery and review queue for a research-only skincare synthesis prototype.
rules: This manifest is not an evidence corpus and must not be passed to the Pinecone ingestion script.
Do not turn retrieved source text into deterministic safety rules without a qualified review process.
Do not use source text to diagnose, prescribe, or replace a dermatologist.
Do not scrape or ingest EWG Skin Deep data without written permission.

sources.title: Final Report of the Safety Assessment of Niacinamide and Niacin
sources.intended_use: Ingredient-safety provenance only; not evidence of treatment effectiveness.
sources.rights_note: CIR terms do not clearly grant automated extraction, vector embedding, or redistribution. Obtain permission before storing source text or derived chunks.
sources.review_note: Retain source locator and conclusion scope; do not generalise cosmetic-safety findings to medical treatment.

sources.title: Amended Safety Assessment of Salicylic Acid and Salicylates as Used in Cosmetics
sources.intended_use: Ingredient-safety provenance and formulation-scope context only.
sources.rights_note: Publicly accessible CIR PDF; permission for extraction and vector embedding still needs confirmation.
sources.review_note: Use the newer SCCS salicylic-acid opinion for current regulatory context.

sources.title: Safety Assessment of Ceramides as Used in Cosmetics
sources.intended_use: Ingredient-safety provenance only; use alongside separate clinical evidence for barrier-support claims.
sources.rights_note: Publicly accessible CIR PDF; permission for extraction and vector embedding still needs confirmation.
sources.review_note: Preserve INCI aliases during later curation, including retired names such as Ceramide 1 and Ceramide EOP.

sources.title: Safety Assessment of Retinol and Retinyl Palmitate as Used in Cosmetics
sources.intended_use: Historical ingredient-safety provenance only.
sources.rights_note: Publicly accessible CIR PDF; permission for extraction and vector embedding still needs confirmation.
sources.review_note: Do not use the CIR draft assessment report. Use current SCCS and jurisdictional regulation for contemporary restriction context.

sources.title: Safety Assessment of Benzyl Salicylate
sources.intended_use: Fragrance-ingredient safety provenance only.
sources.rights_note: Publicly accessible CIR PDF; permission for extraction and vector embedding still needs confirmation.
sources.review_note: Do not infer universal fragrance tolerance from this source.

sources.title: Salicylic acid (CAS No. 69-72-7, EC No. 200-712-3)
sources.source: European Commission Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety
sources.intended_use: Current regulatory-safety context, subject to jurisdictional and product-category review.
sources.rights_note: Use as a manual regulatory reference until reuse/AI-processing terms are confirmed; retain the exact final version.
sources.review_note: Not a treatment protocol; restrictions vary by product form, concentration, exposure route, and population.

sources.title: Revision of the scientific Opinion on Vitamin A (Retinol, Retinyl Acetate, Retinyl Palmitate)
sources.source: European Commission Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety
sources.intended_use: Current regulatory-safety context for vitamin-A cosmetic ingredients.
sources.rights_note: Use as a manual regulatory reference until reuse/AI-processing terms are confirmed; retain the exact final version.
sources.review_note: Not a treatment protocol; do not treat a regulatory concentration conclusion as individual medical suitability.

sources.title: Acne vulgaris: management
sources.source: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.intended_use: Primary clinical-governance source for acne-related retrieval and escalation boundaries.
sources.rights_note: Publicly readable, but NICE terms require approval/licensing for AI use. Keep as a manual reference; do not ingest into Pinecone without written permission.
sources.review_note: Contains prescription and referral guidance. The app must keep those behind clinical-review and escalation rules.

sources.title: American Academy of Dermatology issues updated guidelines for the management of acne
sources.intended_use: Citation and update-awareness source only.
sources.rights_note: Use as a link/citation. Obtain the underlying guideline through a permitted source before extracting evidence.
sources.review_note: Do not use this press summary as a substitute for the full guideline evidence or recommendations.

sources.title: Moisturizers for Acne: What are their Constituents?
sources.source: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology
sources.intended_use: Supporting background for tolerability and moisturizer-category retrieval.
sources.rights_note: PMC availability alone is not an embedding licence. Verify the article's displayed licence and reuse terms before creating derived chunks.
sources.review_note: Narrative/product-ingredient review, not a substitute for acne treatment guidance.

sources.title: Topical Sunscreens: A Narrative Review for Contact Sensitivity, Potential Allergens, Clinical Evaluation, and Management for their Optimal Use in Clinical Practice
sources.intended_use: Photoprotection and sensitivity context for research retrieval.
sources.rights_note: Article states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; ensure the project use remains licence-compatible and retain attribution.
sources.review_note: Do not convert general photoprotection discussion into individual allergy or disease advice.

sources.title: Topical and Systemic Therapies in Melasma: A Systematic Review
sources.intended_use: Hyperpigmentation evidence discovery, with only non-prescription, clinically reviewed material eligible for the prototype.
sources.rights_note: Article states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; ensure the project use remains licence-compatible and retain attribution.
sources.review_note: Contains prescription and systemic-therapy discussion; never expose those as autonomous routine advice.

sources.title: Impact of airborne particulate matter on skin: a systematic review from epidemiology to in vitro studies
sources.intended_use: Evidence context for passing measured particulate data into a cautious retrieval query.
sources.rights_note: Verify the displayed article licence and retain attribution before creating derived chunks.
sources.review_note: Association/mechanism evidence is not a real-time diagnostic or a justification for a medical claim.

sources.title: WHO global air quality guidelines: particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), ozone, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide
sources.intended_use: Public-health context for measured environmental inputs and provenance display.
sources.rights_note: WHO executive-summary material is published under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; confirm the relevant document licence and attribution before reuse.
sources.review_note: Not skincare-specific and not a substitute for real-time local AQI categories or medical advice.

sources.title: PRACT-India: Practical Recommendations on Acne Care and Medical Treatment in India—A Modified Delphi Consensus
sources.intended_use: Open-licence acne-care evidence discovery, weighted below formal guidelines.
sources.rights_note: CC BY content can be reused with attribution; retain the licence and source attribution in all derived records.
sources.review_note: Several authors have Glenmark affiliations. Preserve that conflict flag and do not expose prescription advice as autonomous routine output.

sources.title: Consensus Guidelines for the Treatment of Atopic Dermatitis in Korea (Part I): General Management and Topical Treatment
sources.intended_use: Non-commercial academic evidence discovery for barrier-care concepts.
sources.rights_note: CC BY-NC use requires attribution and a non-commercial use context.
sources.review_note: Limit any later claims to atopic-dermatitis barrier care; do not turn it into eczema diagnosis or general sensitive-skin advice.

sources.title: A daily regimen of a ceramide-dominant moisturizing cream and cleanser restores the skin permeability barrier in adults with moderate eczema
sources.intended_use: Open-licence evidence for barrier and hydration concepts, with product-specific limitations visible.
sources.rights_note: CC BY content can be reused with attribution; retain source and licence metadata in derived records.
sources.review_note: Do not convert this study into brand recommendations or generalize its eczema population beyond the supported scope.

sources.title: Spectrum of sensitive skin in India: a collaborative expert position statement
sources.intended_use: Open-licence contextual retrieval for gentle-routine and environmental-sensitivity research.
sources.rights_note: CC BY content can be reused with attribution; retain source and licence metadata in derived records.
sources.review_note: Weight below formal clinical guidelines and retain India-specific scope and industry-affiliation flag.

sources.title: Photoaging: Update on Pathogenesis, Prevention, and Treatment
sources.intended_use: Non-commercial academic evidence discovery for photoprotection and photoaging explanations.
sources.rights_note: CC BY-NC use requires attribution and a non-commercial use context.
sources.review_note: Avoid product-specific claims and route all retinoid suitability through explicit safety rules and clinician review.

sources.title: Tretinoin for Photodamaged Facial Skin: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
sources.intended_use: Non-commercial academic evidence discovery for a research-only retinoid evidence layer.
sources.rights_note: CC BY-NC use requires attribution and a non-commercial use context.
sources.review_note: Tretinoin is a medicine in many jurisdictions. Keep pregnancy, irritation, and referral safeguards outside retrieval and do not autonomously recommend it.

sources.title: Air Pollutant Index (API)
sources.intended_use: Malaysia-local API explanation and UI provenance for a local environmental mode.
sources.rights_note: Link to the official page; do not copy site content into the vector corpus without permission.
sources.review_note: Keep Malaysia's API distinct from a provider-reported US AQI value.

sources.title: CosIng – Cosmetic ingredient database
sources.intended_use: Future INCI/CAS normalization and direct regulatory provenance links.
sources.rights_note: Use as an informative link and verify database terms before any bulk extraction.
sources.review_note: CosIng is informative and non-binding; an ingredient listing is not a universal safe/unsafe determination.

sources.title: About Skin Deep Cosmetics Database
sources.intended_use: Optional direct-link comparison view only, if the research protocol explicitly calls for it.
sources.rights_note: Do not scrape, store, or redistribute Skin Deep database content without written permission. Its terms restrict substantial database use.
sources.review_note: EWG scores are hazard-oriented and do not replace exposure-aware risk assessment, regulatory restrictions, or clinical judgement.
